title: 第2章 大家都是格调的人
slug: 狗哥你再舔女主我就和黄毛私奔
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“那人呢？现在能过来吗？”

赵楹月预估赵随野最多还有十分钟杀到酒店。

粉毛老实摇头，“我们过来前他还昏迷着，应该来不了了。”

赵楹月瞪他：“那你说什么废话！”

黄毛是临时找不到人了。

那就只能改改剧本。

改成黄毛为了别的女人，放她鸽子，她还要死要活的戏码！

赵楹月眼里装着光，内心的表演欲正在蠢蠢欲动。

“姐，那我们能帮上什么忙？”

虽然不知道赵楹月为什么要假装爱黄毛，但老大就是老大，一定有她的道理！

三小弟唯赵楹月是瞻。

“都出去望风，”赵楹月把人打发走，准备酝酿酝酿情绪，“我哥来了就给我打电话。”

赵随野刚出门不久，就接到了管家的电话。

原本还算温和的面色，在听完那头的陈述后，瞬间变得阴沉起来。

“你说，我妹要去和野男人开房？”

每个字都像是从牙缝里蹦出来似的。

车内气压极低。

饶是司机都有些受不了这个气氛。

“大少爷，千真万确，我听得清清楚楚，绝对不可能出错！”管家笃定又着急的说，“您快去找大小姐吧，她那么单纯善良，一定是被人给骗了！”

挂了电话，赵随野就收到赵楹月发来的消息。

刚把截图点开，扫完上面的全部内容，下一秒就提示对方已撤回。

刹那间，赵随野脑子里只剩下一个念头：有狗要拱他家的白菜！

疯狂给赵楹月发消息，对方已读不回装死。

赵随野拳头硬了。

几乎是立刻让司机调头，往爱琴海酒店赶。

同时给助理海薇打去电话，让她现在立刻赶去酒吧。

他则留下来先处理赵楹月的事。

赵随野现在非常愤怒。

大家都是有格调的人，他再清楚不过男人肮脏的想法！

居然敢骗他乖乖软软的亲妹妹，真是在海市活腻歪了！

司机欲哭无泪。

在逼仄的气压下，硬生生将半个小时的车程，缩减到了二十分钟。

进了爱情海酒店，赵随野直奔在截图上看到的2409房间。

同一时间，灰、绿、粉三人组把他抵达的消息传给了赵楹月。

男人气势汹汹的找到房间号，人站在门口，才发现门是虚掩着的。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"Where is that person? Can you come here now?"

Zhao Yingyue estimated that Zhao Suiye would reach the hotel in ten minutes at most.

Fenmao shook his head honestly, "He was still unconscious before we came here, so he probably won't be able to come."

Zhao Yingyue glared at him: "Then what nonsense are you talking about!"

Huang Mao couldn't find anyone temporarily.

Then we can only change the script.

Change to Huang Mao for another woman, let her go, and she will still have to live and die!

Zhao Yingyue's eyes were filled with light, and her inner desire to perform was about to stir.

"Sister, how can we help?"

Although I don’t know why Zhao Yingyue pretends to love Huang Mao, the boss is the boss, so she must have a reason!

Only Zhao Yingyue, the third younger brother, looked up to him.

"Let's all go out and watch," Zhao Yingyue sent them away, preparing to work on her emotions. "Call me when my brother comes."

Not long after Zhao Suiye left the house, he received a call from the housekeeper.

His originally gentle complexion instantly turned gloomy after listening to the statement on the other end.

"You said, my sister is going to get a room with a wild man?"

Every word seemed to pop out from between my teeth.

The air pressure inside the car is extremely low.

Even the driver couldn't stand the atmosphere.

"Young Master, it's absolutely true. I heard you clearly. There is absolutely no way I can make a mistake!" the housekeeper said firmly and anxiously, "Go find the eldest lady quickly. She is so simple and kind, she must have been deceived!"

After hanging up the phone, Zhao Suiye received a message from Zhao Yingyue.

I just clicked on the screenshot and scanned all the content above, and the next second I was prompted that the other party had withdrawn it.

In an instant, there was only one thought left in Zhao Suiye's mind: There was a dog trying to eat his cabbage!

He frantically sent a message to Zhao Yingyue, but the other party pretended to be dead since he couldn't read it back.

Zhao Suiye's fist hardened.

Almost immediately, he asked the driver to turn around and rush to the Aegean Hotel.

At the same time, he called his assistant Heiwei and asked her to rush to the bar immediately.

He stayed to deal with Zhao Yingyue's affairs first.

Zhao Suiye is very angry now.

Everyone is a person of style, and he knows very well the dirty thoughts of men!

He actually dared to lie to his obedient and soft sister, he was really tired of living in the sea market!

The driver wanted to cry but had no tears.

Under the tight air pressure, the half-hour drive was suddenly reduced to twenty minutes.

After entering the Aegean Hotel, Zhao Suiye went straight to room 2409 that he saw on the screenshot.

At the same time, the gray, green, and pink trio conveyed the news of his arrival to Zhao Yingyue.

The man found the room number aggressively, and when he stood at the door, he realized that the door was ajar.
